origin.thread_label: Alpha Lab adversarial operator anticipation / denominator enrichment

title: Enrich frozen adversarial launch denominator with pre-T0 qualification evidence
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic SHADOW-ONLY enrichment needed to make the already-frozen 88-launch adversarial counting interval interpretable. Reuse existing Robinhood RPC, Blockscout and counting owners. Enrich each input launch with only pre-T0 launch-preparation/funding evidence plus at most T0..T0+1 launch-inventory evidence, preserve explicit UNKNOWN states, apply self-exemption and benign-infrastructure controls, and then execute the existing frozen counting contract without changing thresholds or qualification semantics. Do not create a new scanner, scheduler, score, alert rule, trading engine, API budget or portfolio authority.
allowed_change_scope: Donh91/Investering-Framework-Archive-v1:research/api_agent/meme_alpha/experiments/** only for an output/enrichment schema that does not change frozen qualification semantics
Donh91/Investering-Framework-Archive-v1:scripts/api_agent/meme_alpha_blockscout.py only for a generic read-only history helper
Donh91/Investering-Framework-Archive-v1:scripts/api_agent/meme_alpha_robinhood_pons_v2.py only for generic bounded receipt/log retrieval reused by the enrichment

evidence.summary: The deterministic counting executor correctly stopped at INCOMPLETE_SOURCE_EVIDENCE because all 88 frozen rows lack load-bearing qualification enrichment.
Counting code and 14 focused tests are already merged; the next bounded requirement is source enrichment, not threshold tuning.
Existing Blockscout transport already supports authenticated PRO with public fallback and arbitrary read-only /api/v2 paths without persisting credentials.
Existing Robinhood RPC owner already provides chain-checked bounded log/event access and must be reused.
Independent source-feasibility research found the 88-row enrichment is testable, identified a self-exemption trap, and established UNKNOWN_HUB and anti-leakage requirements.

reproduction: From fresh main, run the existing adversarial_operator_counting.py against the frozen 88-row manifest. Confirm the receipt remains INCOMPLETE_SOURCE_EVIDENCE because pre_t0_prep_observed, common funding/operator evidence, privileged launch surface and related qualification fields are absent. Confirm repository RPC/Blockscout owners can retrieve launch transaction/calldata and bounded address history. The defect is reproduced when the frozen scientific counting contract is executable but the selected outcome-blind source interval cannot be classified without a deterministic enrichment layer.

positive: A bounded enrichment invocation accepts the immutable 88-row manifest and preserves every input launch row, including enrichment failures.
Launch calldata/receipt evidence is decoded without outcome lookup and records the raw snipeTaxExemptions list where available.
Third-party privileged exemptions exclude deployer, recipient and tx_from so automatic/self exemption cannot create a false privilege signal.
All pre-T0 history-derived features discard rows after launch T0; launch-inventory evidence is capped at T0..T0+1 block and an as_of_block_max is persisted.
Pre-T0 preparation becomes TRUE only from launch-relevant preparation evidence; unrelated prior wallet activity remains contextual.
Common funding becomes FALSE only with sufficiently complete relevant histories; missing or truncated histories stay UNKNOWN.
Named protocol/router/Relay/bridge/CEX/factory infrastructure cannot satisfy common-funding/operator qualification.
An unlabeled high-throughput EOA meeting the frozen >=10000 transaction ambiguity rule is classified UNKNOWN_HUB and cannot qualify as benign infrastructure or operator evidence.
Direct operator lineage in v1 is set TRUE only from exact deterministic matches to already-frozen historical evidence, never from same factory/router or similarity alone.
No price, return, ATH, caller reputation, later distribution outcome or future token performance is read or emitted during enrichment.
The enriched manifest is consumable by the already-merged adversarial_operator_counting.py without changing its frozen <=10/day and 50% infrastructure semantics.
One bounded receipt for the frozen interval resolves to an interpretable counting state or explicitly NOT_MEASURABLE_WITH_CURRENT_FREE_SOURCES with source-health reasons.
negative: No missing field may be converted to zero, false, no-risk or no-hit unless the required source coverage proves absence.
No post-T0 transaction history may influence pre-T0 funding/preparation fields.
Router-emitted self exemption alone must not create privileged_bundle_evidence.
A high-throughput unlabeled EOA must not be auto-classified as CEX, Relay, benign infrastructure or operator.
No multi-hop beneficial-owner inference, deanonymization or real-world identity claim is permitted.
No outcome fields may be joined before the enriched qualification row and counting result are frozen.
No review-budget threshold, Stage A/Stage B semantic, alert rule, market gate, model weight or API budget may change.
No new workflow, scheduler, parallel runtime, evidence ledger, scanner or trading authority may be created.
